requirement: Export site as ZIP and Backup download dialogs end on a disabled Downloaded button, accept digits only, and keep non-code refusals out of the code step

oracle.ref: PR #1419 (fix); fix evidence: Before this change both dialogs returned to the Send code step after the download link was handed to the browser, and every download refusal read as a wrong code
oracle.invariant: S1: the dialog shows 'Download started.', the primary button reads Downloaded and is disabled, the code field is gone, and every part stays inside the 360px viewport. S2: same end state: Downloaded disabled, no code field. S3: no letter is accepted and Download stays disabled. S4: the destructive failed alert with Try again / Close shows, not the inline wrong-code text. S5: the code door is called again and no new POST /backup is made.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
